S4b.tree.willow_15468.why: big old bare willow forking into two leaders, a long nearly level west limb over the road to the tea house, whips fanning from the crown: willow, the great willow with a long west limb; willow_fan variant 1 (a thick trunk leaning a little west with one long limb reaching west); not mirrored: it leans as drawn

S4b.tree.far_bank_15308.why: faint far-bank tree at the silk's top, a thick trunk leaning north-east (conf low; a far crown): willow; willow_fan variant 2 (tall and upright, three steep limbs, the crown lopsided east), not willow_fan_1: S3.tree.willow_crown_top_15520 stands on it 2.6 m away; mirrored for its lean, as painted

S4b.tree.young_tree_15275.why: young bare tree with upright budding twigs, its slender stem leaning and arching north-east (conf low): shoot tree, the narrow forking one; shoot_tree variant 3 (a trunk leaning a little west, forking into two limbs, narrow); mirrored for its lean, as painted

S4b.tree.far_bank_15230.why: faint far-bank tree of two short stems cut by the silk's top (conf low; a far crown): willow, twin trunks; willow_fan variant 3 (twin trunks from one foot)

S4b.tree.stump_14805.why: a short, thick, gnarled trunk outlined in moss dots, hooking east to a dark knob, no crown (conf low): built as a solid model in S4b's kit (kit_outer_road_2), not a card (catalogue §5)

S4b.tree.willow_head_14470.why: bare whips springing from a knob in a round crown behind the tea house, trunk unseen (conf low): willow, the round crown; willow_fan variant 4 (a short stout trunk dividing low into a round crown)

S4b.tree.willow_head_14300.why: bare whips fanning upward above the big elm's crown, head and trunk hidden (conf low): willow, tall and upright; willow_fan variant 2 (tall and upright, three steep limbs, the crown lopsided east)

S4b.tree.willow_head_14090.why: fine bare whips radiating upward from a knob over the big elm's fork, trunk unseen (conf low): willow; willow_fan variant 3 (twin trunks from one foot)

S4b.tree.forked_elm_14045.why: big bare elm whose two stems part from one root base: the west stem leans far north-west over the wheelwright's shed, the east one rises: elm, two stems from one foot; elm_claw variant 5 (two stems from one foot, the west one leaning out); not mirrored: it leans as drawn

S4b.tree.gnarled_13318.why: leaning knotted trunk from the crowd's back forking into two limbs that each throw a fan of fine whips, the east one spreading wide over the top-street stall: willow; willow_fan variant 1 (a thick trunk leaning a little west with one long limb reaching west); mirrored for its lean, as painted

S4b.tree.gnarled_13085.why: old bare tree with a thick knotted dark trunk and crooked branches hung with dark twig clumps: elm; elm_claw variant 2 (upright, with a hollow)

S4b.tree.elm_twin_12976.why: the eastern of a pair of tall straight bare trunks 0.7 m apart, rising to the top of the silk: slender, dead straight; slender variant 1 (dead straight, a few twigs at the top); mirrored to differ from S4.tree.straight_trunk_12192 on the same card 9.4 m away

S4b.tree.elm_twin_12921.why: tall straight bare trunk to the top of the silk, dark dotted bud clusters on its upper branches (elm-like): the tall slender elm with a small high crown; elm_claw variant 6 (a tall slender trunk with a small high claw crown)
